import sys, importlib.util, pathlib
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('awm', 'audit_writing_memory.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
text = sys.stdin.read()
rules, paths = m.build_rules(pathlib.Path(r'D:\BaiduSyncdisk\.agents\vocab'), 'zh', 'research-report')

hits = [(r.source, r.suggestion, r.exception, h.group(0)) for r in rules for h in r.compiled.finditer(visible)]

for h in hits: print(h)
